net.minecraft.network.syncher.SyncedDataHolder, net.minecraft.world.entity.Attackable, net.minecraft.world.level.entity.EntityAccess, net.minecraft.world.Nameable, net.minecraft.world.scores.ScoreHolder, net.minecraftforge.common.capabilities.ICapabilityProvider, net.minecraftforge.common.capabilities.ICapabilityProviderImpl<net.minecraft.world.entity.Entity>, net.minecraftforge.common.capabilities.ICapabilitySerializable<net.minecraft.nbt.CompoundTag>, net.minecraftforge.common.extensions.IForgeEntity, net.minecraftforge.common.extensions.IForgeLivingEntity, net.minecraftforge.common.extensions.IForgePlayer, net.minecraftforge.common.extensions.IForgeServerPlayer, net.minecraftforge.common.util.INBTSerializable<net.minecraft.nbt.CompoundTag>
public final class ForgeAutomationPlayer extends net.minecraft.server.level.ServerPlayer
Stable Forge automation player used by dispenser-owned actions. Forge has no fake-player type on this version, so this is a plain ServerPlayer that is never added to the player list: it has no connection, so messages sent to it are discarded, and it records no statistics. One instance is cached per loaded server level and dropped when that level unloads.
